title: Starter Guide — Atomic Elements Reference
description: A clean, self-contained reference page showing how Atomic Elements blocks compose in JSON and how to replace this file with your own page.

props.title: How Portaless pages are built
props.subtitle: This is the single reference page included in the starter profile. Every section below is rendered from JSON using Atomic Elements — with zero external images and zero fictional data.

props.text: Each file under site-profiles/starter/pages/ declares a version, slug, title, description, theme, and a root array of typed blocks. Portaless compiles each JSON file into a static route at /pages/<slug>/ and registers it in /explore/ and /sitemap.xml.
Use Columns with columnSlots to place blocks side by side on desktop and stack them cleanly on mobile screens.
Button blocks link to internal routes (such as /blog/ or /) or external documentation without hand-written HTML.

props.items:
server :: Hero & Heading :: Introduce a route with a spotlight hero and divide sections with accessible heading levels and optional eyebrows.
package :: Paragraph & Columns :: Combine readable prose with responsive multi-column slots that adapt down to narrow mobile viewports.
shield :: FeatureGrid & FAQ :: Summarize workflows in structured cards and answer common operational questions in expandable disclosures.
bot :: Button & PostList :: Connect pages, blog posts, and external links while keeping the page schema portable for both visual editing and MCP agents.

props.title: Replacing or duplicating this page
props.items:
How do I create my own page? :: Copy starter-guide.json inside site-profiles/starter/pages/, give it a new filename and matching slug, edit the blocks, and run npm run build.
Can I delete this starter guide? :: Yes. Remove starter-guide.json once you have added your own pages or if you only need the home page and blog.
Where can I see more layout examples? :: The official showcase with fictional demos lives in the external portaless-templates repository and live demo site.
